# How to Reset Waste Ink Counters in Epson Printers with WIC Reset Utility V3.01
 
WIC Reset Utility is a software tool that allows you to reset the waste ink counters in Epson inkjet printers. Waste ink counters are used to measure the amount of ink that is used for cleaning the print head and other maintenance functions. When the waste ink counters reach a certain level, the printer will stop working and display an error message such as "Service required" or "Ink pads are at the end of their service life". To continue using your printer, you need to reset the waste ink counters.
